data.title: The More Life Company Reports Positive Third-Party Agrarius Potato Trial Results in Brazil
data.description: The More Life Company Corp. (TMLC) announced successful results from an independent field trial assessing their Agrarius™ agricultural plant signaling technology in Brazil. The study revealed significant improvements in potato crops, with up to a 32.5% increase in special-grade potatoes and a 27.6% increase in total potato yield compared to the control group. The trial was conducted independently and demonstrated the effectiveness of TMLC's licensed technology.

data.title: Eon, CancerIQ Partner to Find At-Risk Patients Earlier and Drive Completion of Recommended Care
data.description: A recent collaboration between health systems now offers two avenues of access to a shared standard. The primary focus is on ensuring that no patients in jeopardy slip through the cracks, while also guaranteeing that all suggested follow-up actions are carried out without fail. Taking place on September 15, 2026, in Denver and Chicago, this partnership involves Eon, a prominent figure in the field of incidental discoveries and preemptive detection solutions. data.title: DeVore Design Launches Scannable "AI Disclosure" Badge, Proposes Industry Standard for Enhanced Real Estate Listing Photos

data.title: Agiloft Research Reveals Hidden Procurement Value Gap: 52% of Enterprises Miss Contractual Remedies as Supplier Spend Flows Off-Contract
data.description: An analysis reveals that 82% of procurement teams currently have responsibility for managing contracts. Surprisingly, over 50% of these teams have failed to utilize contractual remedies within the last year. Additionally, it has been identified that a minimum of 15% of supplier expenditure occurs outside of the agreed-upon contracts. This report comes out just before Agiloft is set to showcase at the 2026 Gartner® event.
